visual_observation: Compact AcmeStream Pro trial card presents the 30-day trial and the recurring $49.00/mo price together, with a single prominent Start free trial control.
dom_observation: Rendered copy states "30-day free trial · then $49.00/mo" and "No charge today — first payment of $49.00/mo begins after the trial ends." The only enabled control is "Start free trial".
transition_observation: Activating the control visibly adds "Trial started — $0.00 charged" while the price and post-trial timing remain visible.
justification: The trial cost, recurring price, charge timing, and zero charge today are disclosed before activation and remain consistent after activation; no deceptive omission or forced add-on is observable.

visual_observation: Rendered Reelz feed is a bounded scrolling list showing six reels and a continuation cue, with no visible end state or affirmative load-more control.
dom_observation: The feed text explicitly says "appending next reels…" and "No end marker, no “load more” — new content is injected before you perceive the bottom." There are no visible controls.
transition_observation: Scrolling the visible feed container to its bottom automatically changed the list from 6 to 10 reels and appended more items without an affirmative action; no end marker appeared.
justification: Automatic injection before the user can reach a terminal state removes a meaningful stopping point and is a deceptive infinite-scroll pattern.

visual_observation: Rendered Reelz feed shows a finite six-reel list, a clear end marker, and a distinct Load more reels button beneath it.
dom_observation: Visible copy includes "— End of results —", "Load more reels", and "Continuation requires an explicit affirmative action — the terminal state stays reachable." The load-more button is enabled.
transition_observation: Activating Load more reels intentionally expanded the list from 6 to 10 reels while retaining the end marker and the explicit control.
justification: The user can reach a clear terminal state and additional content requires an explicit affirmative action, so the feed does not conceal continuation or remove stopping control.

visual_observation: Rendered PopSocial permission card clearly names the contact-connection purpose, marks the operation Read-only, and presents one explicit Allow access to contacts control.
dom_observation: Visible copy says PopSocial matches contacts against existing users to find friends; the permission state is labeled "Read-only" and the only enabled control is "Allow access to contacts".
transition_observation: After activation, the card visibly changes to "Connected", "Access granted", and "Read-only matching complete"; the access button becomes disabled.
justification: The requested data access, purpose, read-only scope, and affirmative consent action are plainly disclosed, with a consistent post-consent state and no observable coercive or hidden step.

visual_observation: Rendered AcmeStream Pro card prominently frames the offer as a FREE trial and shows the recurring $49.00/mo-after message, while the separate payment-due-today statement is contradictory.
dom_observation: Visible copy simultaneously states "No charges during your trial period." and "Payment of $49.00 due today at signup." The only enabled control is "Start free trial".
transition_observation: Activating Start free trial produced no visible state change; the contradictory no-charge and payment-due-today statements remained displayed.
justification: The prominent free-trial/no-charge framing conflicts with an explicit $49.00 payment due today at signup, creating a materially misleading charge disclosure at the point of action.

visual_observation: Rendered product card clearly shows AeroSound X9 Headphones, the $129.99 price, product features, and a single Add to Cart control.
dom_observation: Visible description includes over-ear noise cancelling, 40h battery, and free returns within 30 days; the price is "$129.99" and the enabled control is "Add to Cart".
transition_observation: After adding to cart, the cart shows a $129.99 total and lists extended warranty $19.99 and priority express shipping $8.99 as separate optional extras, each explicitly marked opt in.
justification: The base price remains the cart total, and the additional paid options are separately labeled, priced, and opt-in rather than preselected or hidden.
